**Original Webtoon:**  
[Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EC%B2%AD%EC%86%8C%ED%95%98%EB%8A%94-%EB%8C%80%ED%95%99%EB%8F%99%EA%B8%B0/2919), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/60736808)  
Kwon Hae-sol, who has foreign oil, grew up envious of others in a well-to-do environment, Due to his extremely introverted personality, he became the so-called 'Asa'. Lee Jin-joo of the Outer River is living in a complex network of relationships On behalf of my father, who lost contact. He is in charge of his sister by working hard. In order to take care of Haesol, who is not good at cleaning, Haesol's mother We spent a lot of money recruiting part-timers to clean up, The lucky child who saved this GodGOD part-time job It was Jinju, Haesol's unrequited love opponent! College life, human relationships, past, present and future, love. in their early 20s, when everything is still difficult, No matter who sees it, two people from "other" human types meet. A story that is different but empathizes, understands even if unfamiliar.
